dossier.title: Architecture decision: Monolith or microservices
dossier.subtitle: Evaluated both paths. Chose monolith for now because we lack operational maturity for services.

blocks.text: We evaluated splitting the codebase into three services: auth, API, and compute. We chose to stay monolithic for now. The operational cost of microservices (deployment, monitoring, debugging) would exceed any benefit until we reach 500 QPS.
The decision is not permanent. We marked three services as 'extract when scaling becomes a bottleneck'. The code is organized so extraction is a bounded task.

left.label: Monolith
left.value:
Deploy: all or nothing
Debug: one service
Scale: whole system

right.label: Microservices
right.value:
Deploy: per service
Debug: trace across three
Scale: independent

pages.title: When to revisit
pages.summary: Triggering conditions for re-evaluating this decision.

items.text: Sustained traffic reaches 300 QPS (currently 100 QPS, growing 10% per quarter)
OR compute capacity becomes the bottleneck in production
OR auth or API becomes a performance hotspot that needs separate optimization

blocks.text: At that point we will revisit. Extraction takes an estimated 4 weeks per service. We will do auth first (lowest risk), then compute (highest value), then API.
